author: Praxis II
title: Diagnostics (test mode): Directed reciprocity probe (kd18/kd22/shuffle/no-cap)
abstract: Fix reciprocity artifact (symmetrization makes reciprocity=1). Build four DAQB variants in-situ and compute reciprocity on the DIRECTED graph before symmetrization; report correlations with cross-batch fraction and a density proxy. Persist summary to shared storage.

original_submission.content:
import os, sys
sys.path.append('storage')

import anndata as ad
import scanpy as sc
from shared.diagnostics.reciprocity_probe_in_situ import probe_variants

def test(adata: ad.AnnData):
    print("=== Directed reciprocity probe (in-situ) ===")
    out = "storage/shared/diagnostics/probe_directed_summary.txt"
    probe_variants(adata, out)
    print(f"[directed_probe] summary saved to {out}")
    return "directed_reciprocity_probe_completed"
